summary_1line: Vishwamitra proposes marriages for Bharata and Shatrughna, and King Janaka agrees to wed all four daughters to Dasaratha’s four sons on an auspicious day.

image_candidates.scene_text: In Janaka’s court, the sages Vishwamitra and Vasistha stand before the kings as Janaka humbly offers his daughters’ hands to the four princes.
King Janaka with folded palms respectfully addresses the two great sages while the princes and courtiers watch in the royal hall of Mithila.
